title: aspilia oblonga
intro: Aspilia oblonga, commonly known as African tea or Aspilia, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Aspilia oblonga include reducing oxidative stress, improving immune function, and exhibiting potential anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable plant for traditional medicine and further scientific research.
